# Quick Sync - Live Demo Webinar
Date: 2026-09-04 | Duration: 33m

## Summary
The team agreed to expand demo delivery from Logan to Scott and Alyssa, using Logan’s certification process, recorded demos, scripts, webinars, and practice sessions to ensure consistency while allowing Logan to focus on enterprise deals. Demos generally run for 20–30 minutes followed by about five minutes of questions, using Demo Fly for standard presentations and live Postgres customer data for specialized use cases. The primary goals are education and sign-ups for Growth Book or sales demos, supported by follow-up emails and sales outreach. The team also discussed automated QR codes, direct links, and chat integrations to improve conversions and share documentation faster during webinars. Zoom remains the current platform, with a future platform upgrade anticipated. Conference participation will be handled cautiously to respect exclusivity rules, protect partner relationships, and prioritize high-impact opportunities. Lyndsie is developing a repository for speaking opportunities and CFP reminders, while the team continues to emphasize collaborative practice, quick support, and respectful event communication.

## Keywords
Demo Certification, Webinar, Sponsorship, Lightning Talk, Conference CFP, Demo Automation

## Action Items

**Logan Bates**
Share demo certification materials and demo script with Scott Bailey and Alyssa Nicoll to prepare them for running demos (02:06)
Provide ongoing demo support and be available for questions or quick calls to assist Scott Bailey and Alyssa Nicoll as they transition into running demos (10:56)

**Lyndsie Berens**
Send link to recorded demo webinar to Alyssa Nicoll and Scott Bailey so they can review a full demo session (02:46)
Add Scott Bailey and Alyssa Nicoll as panelists in the next recurring webinar to allow them to observe live demos before leading (05:09)
Coordinate with Ashley Stirrup to verify and provide organizer contact details for the Circus conference to ensure proper outreach and communication (20:11)
Continue updating and managing the master repository of conference CFPs and speaking session opportunities to streamline event participation planning (17:30)

**Alyssa Nicoll**
Apply for a Lightning Talks slot at the Circus conference and follow up with organizers to offer longer talks if possible, ensuring transparency about Growth Book's role (15:51)
Send Lightning Talk proposals to Scott Bailey for review before submitting to conference organizers to ensure alignment and quality (23:11)

calls.summary:
# Quick Sync - 2027 Initial Thoughts for Board
Date: 2026-11-06 | Duration: 42m

## Summary
The discussion established that 2027 planning depends on clarifying whether experimentation or feature flagging leads the product position, which will shape ICPs, events, messaging, and growth plans. Board priorities should remain high-level, covering product-led growth, customer expansion and retention, awareness, events, and demand generation. Branded search, LinkedIn, dinners, and recurring live demos showed promise, while non-branded search spent $36k with zero pipeline and one-off webinars produced 24 deals but no wins. ABM should begin with existing-account expansion, which represents roughly half of pipeline, although account ownership and Rio signal accuracy require improvement. Product-led growth should increase signups, identify paywall and usage signals, and convert qualified Pro users into Enterprise customers. Growth is constrained by discovery-stage deal stalls, weak sales follow-through, poor lead tracking, inflated opportunity values, and insufficient segmentation of Pro-versus-Enterprise losses. Customer marketing, thought leadership, community activity, and action-oriented battle cards were also proposed.

## Keywords
Demand generation, Account-based marketing, Product-led growth, Experimentation, Pipeline quality, Thought leadership
